messages:
Rina Shah: quick flag from manual QA — toolbar compact variant compresses at 360px, icon sits nearly flush with label and it looks clipped on Android. screenshot attached.
Owen Lee: saw that on preview too. We switched a few components to spacing.tight last sprint; probably the cause.
Priya Patel: proposal: don't change spacing.tight globally. Add component tokens: --btn-compact-gap: 10px and --btn-compact-pad-x: 12px. Keep vertical padding 6px to preserve 44px hit target.
Dmitri Volkov: dev concern — avoid touching base spacing tokens. I'll wire CSS vars for component override: fallback to original tokens. Will add migration note.
Rina Shah: also toasts are rendering above the new onboarding modal header on integrations page. z-indexs are inconsistent across apps.
Owen Lee: layering pain. We currently have hard z numbers sprinkled around. Suggest semantic layer tokens: layer.toast, layer.fab, layer.modal, then a runtime map per app so we can tweak without changing code.
Priya Patel: product copy preference: toast CTAs should be terse — "Undo" or "Open" not full sentences. Tooltips should show human copy, not token names.
Dmitri Volkov: pushed a small experiment to a branch: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/compare/toolbar-gap-fix
snippet:
```
:root { --btn-compact-gap: 10px; --btn-compact-pad-y: 6px; --layer-toast: 1200; --layer-modal: 1100; }
.button--compact { padding: var(--btn-compact-pad-y) 12px; gap: var(--btn-compact-gap); min-width:44px; min-height:44px; }
.toast { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: var(--layer-toast); }
.modal { z-index: var(--layer-modal); }
@media (max-width:420px) { .toast-stack { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; } }
```
Owen Lee: ran visual diffs — compact buttons look better; a couple micro shifts in toolbar alignment, posting screenshots now.
ux-bot: accessibility checks: ensure icon-only buttons include aria-label; confirm :focus-visible styles; enforce 44px touch target; toasts should use aria-live="polite" for non-critical and role="alert" for errors; if toast has action, ensure keyboard focusable control and sane tab order.
Priya Patel: can we add this checklist to the component PR template? Also add a short changelog blurb about token names and migration steps.
Rina Shah: yes — scheduling a 20-minute sync after standup to finalize token names & copy. /remind me in 20
ux-bot: Reminder set for Rina Shah in 20 minutes.
